curl 'https://app.example.com/api/items' \
  -H 'accept: application/json, text/plain, */*' \
  -H 'accept-language: en-GB,en;q=0.9' \
  -H 'authorization: Bearer hdr.fake-token==' \
  -H 'cache-control: no-cache' \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -b 'sid=s%3Aab.c%2F; tok=eyJhbGc==' \
  -H 'origin: https://app.example.com' \
  -H 'pragma: no-cache' \
  -H 'priority: u=1, i' \
  -H 'referer: https://app.example.com/dashboard' \
  -H 'sec-ch-ua: "Chromium";v="130", "Google Chrome";v="130", "Not?A_Brand";v="99"' \
  -H 'sec-ch-ua-mobile: ?0' \
  -H 'sec-ch-ua-platform: "Linux"' \
  -H 'sec-fetch-dest: empty' \
  -H 'sec-fetch-mode: cors' \
  -H 'sec-fetch-site: same-origin' \
  -H 'user-agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/130.0.0.0 Safari/537.36' \
  -H 'x-app-client: web 1.2' \
  -H 'x-csrf-token: c"s%20r\f=1' \
  --data-raw '{"q":1}'
